dialogues.speaker: Fortress of Meropide Bulletin Board
dialogues.text: Official announcements by the Fortress of Meropide and other information may be posted here. Not for other use.

dialogues.speaker: Small Print
dialogues.text: The receptionist Monglane is not responsible for any matters related to this board.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Continue Reading

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Leave

dialogues.speaker: Notice
dialogues.text: Notice Reiterating Relevant Production Zone Regulations

dialogues.speaker: Notice
dialogues.text: Bringing items not related to production into the production zone is forbidden, including Genius Invokation TCG cards, books, etc.

dialogues.speaker: Notice
dialogues.text: Complete production work in a timely manner and ensure all products meet quality standards. Be willing to accept technical assistance when necessary.

dialogues.speaker: Notice
dialogues.text: Take good care of equipment! Stealing any production materials or modifying the clockwork meka is strictly forbidden.

dialogues.speaker: Notice
dialogues.text: Applications for external pipe maintenance work are always open! Inquiries regarding requirements and specific job responsibilities should be made with Estienne.

dialogues.speaker: Supplementary Notice
dialogues.text: Those with prior pipe maintenance experience preferred.

dialogues.speaker: Notice
dialogues.text: Graffiti, drawing, or otherwise posting anything on the walls is strictly forbidden, and violators will be punished.

dialogues.speaker: Supplementary Notice
dialogues.text: If you have any experience in removing special paints, please contact Maupoil.

dialogues.speaker: Notice
dialogues.text: All work related to the Geode Mine Shaft has been suspended, and the connecting paths have been sealed.

dialogues.speaker: Notice
dialogues.text: If you require one of the connecting paths to be opened for official Fortress business, you must apply 7 days in advance and operate the drive valve only under the supervision of a technical expert to prevent accidents.

dialogues.speaker: Notice
dialogues.text: There have been many reports of fraud targeting new arrivals. An investigation is underway and the results will be announced after the completion of the investigation.

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Everyone should be on their guard against these scoundrels, especially newcomers."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "I know a guy called Decembre, they said he takes good care of newcomers! If you're new, you can't go wrong if you ask him for help!"

dialogues.speaker: Notice
dialogues.text: The results of the investigation regarding the recent fraud cases, especially perpetrated against newcomers, are hereby posted below:

dialogues.speaker: Notice
dialogues.text: The criminal Decembre used the empathy of others to outsource commissions, having others complete them at low prices and pocketing the difference.

dialogues.speaker: Notice
dialogues.text: As a serious infraction of the Regulations Regarding Credit Coupon Circulation, it is hereby announced the Decembre and his accomplices are to be severely punished.

dialogues.speaker: Notice
dialogues.text: The open selection process for field maintenance staff is underway! Interested parties should contact Estienne.

dialogues.speaker: Notice
dialogues.text: Four groups of candidates have already registered to participate. Future registrants can apply independently or negotiate joining an already registered group of candidates.

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Our team is recruiting mature and reliable partners! Come enjoy the pleasure of winning the championship and lift the trophy with us."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Recruitment is valid up until the end of the game, so any strong partners should inquire with Rave."

dialogues.speaker: Notice
dialogues.text: The open selection process for field maintenance staff is still ongoing! Parties interested in registering should contact Estienne.

dialogues.speaker: Supplementary Notice
dialogues.text: Based on the current circumstances, it's not that you have no chance at all of being selected if you register now, but the chance is so small, so infinitesimal it might as well be nil.

dialogues.speaker: Notice
dialogues.text: Pankration is a healthy sport!

dialogues.speaker: Notice
dialogues.text: If you'd like to participate in Pankration, borrow the Pankration Ring, or just find someone for a friendly sparring match, please place your inquiries with Roussimoff at the Pankration Ring.

dialogues.speaker: "Tri-Coupon Troupe" Advertisement
dialogues.text: "Some say that only two medicines can cure a multitude of sins. One is time, and the other is silence..."

dialogues.speaker: "Tri-Coupon Troupe" Advertisement
dialogues.text: When her true love dies bearing hatred, and she herself is framed and exiled, will she choose silence, or vengeance?

dialogues.speaker: "Tri-Coupon Troupe" Advertisement
dialogues.text: Amidst nearly boundless enmity, how will her fate sink and resurface?

dialogues.speaker: "Tri-Coupon Troupe" Advertisement
dialogues.text: "The Countess of Monte-Mer," performed by the Tri-Coupon Troupe! Coming soon.

dialogues.speaker: Notice
dialogues.text: In accordance with the Regulations Regarding the Coupon Cafeteria, each person can claim one delicious Welfare Meal each day from Bran.

dialogues.speaker: Notice
dialogues.text: Maintain order and stay in line while claiming your Welfare Meal. Violators will lose Welfare Meal privileges for 3 days.

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Hey! Isn't it supposed to be a 'delicious' Welfare Meal? My Welfare Meal was anything but delicious! I demand an explanation!"

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: "If you have something to say regarding the Welfare Meals, fill out a report with the receptionist. This board doesn't handle such matters."

dialogues.speaker: Hidden Small Print
dialogues.text: "Want something good? Come to the 'Rag and Bone Shop'! It's even better than the 'Rag and Bone Shop' (instead of a period, there is a small orange bulle fruit)"
